text: You're looking for a quick and nutritious meal that fits your vegetarian diet and helps you reach your fiber goal. This Greek Vegetables recipe is a great choice, as it's high in fiber and can be prepared in under 20 minutes. The dish features a variety of vegetables, including green beans, zucchini, and onions, which are all rich in fiber. Additionally, the recipe includes whole grain bread, which provides even more fiber and nutrients. This meal should satisfy your fiber needs and be ready in no time.
